_comment: Golden fixtures for the Local Issue Intersection feature (Phase 0 contract). These encode the §8 acceptance criteria in SPEC.md. In Phase 4 they become an automated suite: 'allowed' outputs must pass the validators; 'forbidden' outputs must be REJECTED (by prompt + post-validation). Snapshots use placeholder figures — wire real Census/turnout values when the data layer lands.

validators.noInventedFigures: Every digit-group in the generated text must also appear in the fixture's snapshot.figures values.
validators.noForeignLocality: The only proper-noun locality permitted in output is snapshot.place; no school/court/board/official/agency name may appear.
validators.documentedPositionsOnly: Output must not contain a policy stance/promise that is not a substring-equivalent of the issue's documented commitment/argument/signature.
validators.lawsuitFraming: Any family-court reference is framed alleged/pending, never as established fact.
validators.gracefulDegradation: no-key / no-snapshot / bad-JSON inputs return source='curated', never an error.

brief: St. Louis County had about 22% turnout in the August 2024 primary (St. Louis County). Matt Grant's documented children-first priority is to champion the CHILD Protection Act and tie federal Title IV-D grant money to states that keep their family courts clean and accountable.
A lawful first step is to learn how your local family court and school board work and attend or observe a public meeting.

items.text: Find out when your local family court or school board meets and observe a public session.

forbidden_examples.text: The St. Louis County Family Court under Judge Smith has mishandled custody cases.
About 31% of St. Louis County households include children, so Matt will increase local court funding.
Matt opposes the Kirkwood R-7 school board's current budget.

brief: In Jefferson County the median household income is about $72000 and the median home value about $215000 (U.S. Census ACS 5-yr 2023). Matt Grant's documented commitment is to go after fraud, waste, and bloated headcount first — so tax relief is funded by efficiency, not gimmicks.
You can track the tax and levy proposals on your local ballot and attend a budget hearing to ask what is driving any proposed increase.

items.text: Attend a public budget hearing and ask officials to cut waste before raising taxes.

forbidden_examples.text: Matt urges Jefferson County to reject Proposition A on the April ballot.
Jefferson County wastes roughly $4 million a year on duplicate programs.

snapshot.note: No on-point local fact for a federal structural reform; turnout unavailable for this county.

brief: Term limits are a federal reform, so there isn't a specific Gasconade County statistic that changes the case. Matt Grant's documented commitment is to support term limits for the House and Senate, with a grandfather clause so reform actually passes.
You can sign and circulate a term-limits pledge and ask every candidate on your ballot to commit.

items.text: Ask every candidate on your ballot to commit to term limits and note who will and won't.

forbidden_examples.text: Gasconade County's 14% turnout shows voters there want term limits enacted by 2026.

fixtures._note: Unresolvable ZIP / no snapshot must return the existing curated plan, never an error and never a fabricated local fact.
